relationships.trigger: The public interface or test seam is unresolved before a test is written.
relationships.sourceEvidence: When the shape of that interface is itself in question, call the Skill tool with codebase-design.

rules.statement: Synthesize decisions already established by the conversation and repository evidence; do not repeat an interview for resolved decisions.
Choose the fewest stable public seams that observe required behavior, and request a decision only when the seam remains materially unresolved.
Record durable implementation decisions without volatile paths or full code; retain only prototype fragments that encode a decision more precisely than prose.
Each task is a narrow, complete, independently verifiable vertical slice sized for one fresh execution context.
Represent only genuine task blockers and derive the ready frontier from satisfied dependencies.
Use expand, bounded migration batches, and contract for wide mechanical changes that cannot remain green as a single vertical slice.
Every task declares observable acceptance criteria that can produce verification evidence.

reviewedMethods.name: research
reviewedMethods.condition: A Design work declares a specific knowledge gap and a bounded research output contract.
reviewedMethods.reason: Primary-source research is useful, but background-agent dispatch and note writes need explicit Work capabilities before bundling.

reviewedMethods.name: prototype
reviewedMethods.condition: A Design work records a concrete design risk, scratch write scope, cleanup rule, and human review point.
reviewedMethods.reason: Throwaway code must not escape the Work write scope or become an undeclared fifth planning artifact.

reviewedMethods.name: domain-modeling
reviewedMethods.condition: A Design work changes domain vocabulary or model boundaries; reading existing vocabulary alone does not trigger it.
reviewedMethods.reason: The fixed Skill is already bundled, but it must not create ADRs or glossary changes for every change by default.

reviewedMethods.name: writing-for-agents
reviewedMethods.condition: Only reviewed writing rules are normalized into the planning Method Profile.
reviewedMethods.reason: The complete Skill is not needed at runtime and must not become a second artifact protocol.

reviewedMethods.name: retro
reviewedMethods.condition: Archive has completed and retrospective feedback is explicitly requested or scheduled as non-blocking work.
reviewedMethods.reason: Retrospective improvements must not block or mutate the active Change lifecycle.
